messages.subject: [ACTION] Document management system maintenance - Sat 15 Feb
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The firm's document management system (Whitfield DMS) will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 15 February until approximately 06:00 Sunday 16 February for a scheduled storage upgrade. Please check in any documents you are working on before Friday COB and avoid local copies. Email will be unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
